Customer care

Returns & Replacement Policy

Your satisfaction with our organic quality is our top priority. We offer a transparent, customer-friendly replacement and refund process.

1. 7-Day Replacement Guarantee

Because food products require strict hygienic integrity, we accept replacement requests within 7 calendar days of delivery in cases of: (a) Damaged or punctured product packaging upon arrival, (b) Incorrect product delivered, (c) Expired or defective batch quality.

2. Non-Returnable Conditions

Due to food safety standards, opened or partially consumed food packs cannot be returned unless a verified quality deviation is established by our quality assurance team. Products purchased under clearance sales or custom bulk wholesale orders are non-returnable unless defective.

3. How to Initiate a Return or Replacement

To request assistance, please email info@jananiagroproducts.com or send a WhatsApp message to +91 93114 16225 with: (1) Your Order ID (e.g. JAP-260811), (2) Clear photographs/video of the issue, (3) Brief description of the problem. Our team will review and approve replacement within 24 hours.

4. Refund Processing Timelines

Upon approval, refunds are initiated back to the original payment source (UPI, Credit/Debit Card, or Bank Account) within 3 to 5 business days. For Cash on Delivery orders, refunds are transferred via direct NEFT/UPI transfer to your bank details.

5. Order Cancellation

You can cancel any order prior to dispatch from our warehouse by contacting our support line. Once dispatched and assigned to courier, orders cannot be cancelled mid-transit.
